cards.original_or_retained_rules: End the very next combat you are forced into before you sustain damage. Your anger level increases 2.

crd_review.corrected_effect: Raise your anger 2 levels. The next time an opponent declares Combat against you, skip that Combat immediately.
crd_review.clarification: Anger gain resolves when the ball is placed in play. Skip ability remains active until an opponent declares Combat against the controller. No entering-Combat effects, draws, or damage. Capture transfers control; skip effects do not stack.
crd_review.source_entry:
Earth Dragon Ball 4 (Saiyan Saga - #76) - When this card is placed in play, increase your
Main Personality’s anger 2 levels. The card’s power to skip the next Combat a player is
forced into “remains active” until that player’s opponent declares Combat. When Combat is
declared this effect skips Combat immediately (do not use “when entering Combat effects,” do
not draw cards, do not take damage). The player who controls Earth Dragon Ball 4 controls
the ability to skip Combat, so if EDB 4 is captured back and forth between 2 players, the
ability to stop Combat does not stack.

cards.final_rules: Raise your anger 2 levels. The next time an opponent declares Combat against you, skip that Combat immediately.

crd_review.applicable_entry: Tien Lv.1 (Saiyan Saga - #82) - “Multi-form allows two physical attacks, one after the other” explained: Multi-form performs two physical attacks. The controlling player performs a physical attack; that player’s opponent defends, the controlling player performs another physical attack, that player’s opponent defends. Then the opponent can attack, and Combat continues as usual. Both physical attacks come from Tien’s Multiform Power, and are not any cards played from your hand.
